ai.title: promptClaudeStream and promptDeepseekStream return ReadableStream
ai.summary: backend/src/claude.ts and backend/src/deepseek-api.ts now return ReadableStream<string> from promptClaudeStream and promptDeepseekStream. AsyncGenerator return type replaced with ReadableStream wrapper in main-prompt.ts. ReadableStream prevents premature cancellation of underlying base streams. Internal refactor, no user-facing behavior change.

eli5.text: The backend now keeps the connection to the AI model open for longer, so the streaming text doesn't get cut off unexpectedly. Previously, the way it sent responses back through the server could cause the flow to stop too early; now it uses a more reliable method that prevents that premature shutdown. This is a behind-the-scenes stability fix for the internal response handling, and you wouldn't notice any change in how the assistant behaves.

ai.title: Fix stream delay and tool call prompt
ai.summary: processStreamWithTags now breaks immediately after streamCompleted to prevent token waste. System prompt clarifies that tool calls are delegations requiring no extra text.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to use a tool, it now stops right away instead of keeping to generate extra text, which saves time and resources. The assistant's instructions were also clarified to make it clear that after calling a tool, you should stop and wait for the result rather than continuing to write analysis or commentary. You might notice slightly faster responses after tool calls, and the assistant will be more concise, avoiding unnecessary follow-up text when delegating tasks.

ai.title: Bump @anthropic-ai/sdk to ^0.36.3 in backend
ai.summary: Update @anthropic-ai/sdk dependency from ^0.33.1 to ^0.36.3 in backend/package.json. Reflects upstream SDK version increment for Anthropic API integration. Scope limited to backend package dependencies and bun.lockb. No user-facing behavior changes expected.

eli5.text: The assistant that powers your experience just got its connection upgraded to the latest version of the service it uses to communicate with Anthropic's models. This is behind-the-scenes maintenance, you won't notice any difference in how things work today. The change only updated the internal integration tools the backend uses, with no new features or visible effects.
